item.title: RUMOR: THE BATMAN: PART II Is Now Looking To Cast TWO Male Antagonists - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: With Black Widow star Scarlett Johansson reportedly eyed for a villain role in The Batman: Part II, a new report claims that Matt Reeves is now on the hunt for two male antagonists.

item.title: THE ODYSSEY Leaked Prologue Features Intense Battle Of Troy, First Look At The Cyclops
item.description: Most of the 6-minute prologue for Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey that's set to screen ahead of Avatar: Fire and Ash has leaked online...

item.title: A-List MCU Veteran Is The Latest Actor To Seemingly Confirm They Will Return In AVENGERS: SECRET WARS
item.description: Veteran MCU actor Paul Bettany—who debuted in 2008's Iron Man—has seemingly confirmed that he'll reprise his role as The Vision in Avengers: Secret Wars.

item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Fantastic Four's Post-SECRET WARS Future, Black Knight's Return, Doctor Doom, And More
item.description: In our latest MCU rumor roundup, we have news on the Fantastic Four's future post-Avengers: Secret Wars, hopes for Kit Harington to return as Black Knight, and more.

item.title: ZOOTOPIA 2 Has Passed $1 Billion At The Worldwide Box Office After Just 17 Days In Theaters
item.description: Disney's animated sequel, Zootopia 2, has now officially passed the $1 billion global box office milestone after less than three weeks in theaters...

item.title: CONFIRMED: Marvel Studios Will Release FOUR Different Trailers For AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY In Theaters
item.description: We now have confirmation that Marvel Studios plans to release four different trailers for Avengers: Doomsday in theaters with Avatar: Fire and Ash. Find out more about this unique rollout here...

item.title: ARMAGEDDON Build-Up Continues In First Look At CAPTAIN AMERICA And WOLVERINE Comics - But Is It A Reboot?
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a first look at Captain America #8 and Wolverine: Weapons of Armageddon #2, two Armageddon lead-in issues coming next March.

item.title: Godzilla Returns In New Look At MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS' Kong-Centric Season 2
item.description: Apple TV has shared a new look at Monarch: Legacy of Montsers Season 2, confirming that even with the spotlight moving to King Kong, the real King of the Monsters—Godzilla—will return.
